description:
INTRO ticket for fz-hwn.27. Pure, behavior-preserving rename that makes the migration greppable. No logic changes; build stays green.

Rename every doomed concept on the proposal.html hit list with a Trash / trash_ trigger so the strangler boundary is visible and the outro ticket has a precise removal target. The trigger means "this is dead, a caller still leans on it."

Three groups to mark (proposal.html "Kill with fire"):

A. Separable surface containers -> become the addressed arrow:
- ActivationKey.input: Vec<Ty>                              identity.rs:64
- CallableSurface { inputs }                                semantic.rs:69
- ContractArrow { params, result, constraints }            contract.rs:15
- FunctionContract { arrows: Vec<ContractArrow> }          contract.rs:22
- AppliedContractArrow { params, result }                  contract.rs:27
- SchemeMatch<T> { params, result }                        contract.rs:115
- ResolvedSpecDecl { params, result, constraints }         type_expr/mod.rs:73

B. Per-position normalization (the conflation engine):
- Types::alpha_normalize_vars / alpha_normalize_vars / alpha_normalize_go   types/mod.rs:406,1650,1656
- 7x alpha_normalize (CallableSurface, CallableDemand, ShapeDemand, RuntimeDemand, CallableFlowFact, ExecutableRuntimeDemand)  semantic.rs:78,149,212,297,342,442
- alpha_normalized_surfaces                                 semantic.rs:421
- normalize_contributions                                  world.rs:762
- canonical_activation_key                                 world.rs:2709

C. Hand-rolled substitution / witness walk -> the Types calculator:
- instantiate_matching_arrow, overlapping_witnesses, contract_witness   contract.rs:137,158,173
- instantiate_match, instantiated_match, surface_sigma, merge_sigma     contract.rs:182,232,239,477
- collect_contract_subst + collect_{var,tuple,list,resource,map,arrow}_subst   contract.rs:247-475
- collect_ambiguous_empty_list_vars                        contract.rs:321
- enum Witness, enum SchemeInstantiation                   contract.rs:108,121

NOTE: line numbers are from proposal.html at authoring time; re-verify against HEAD before renaming (resolve.rs/world.rs have moved). Mark, do not delete -- replacements land in later tickets; removal is the outro (fz-hwn.27 acceptance: grep -rn "Trash\|trash_" src/ returns nothing).

Checks
- Pure rename: lib + fixture matrix green, zero warnings, from a fresh uniquely-marked run.
- Every hit-list symbol above carries the Trash / trash_ trigger; grep -rn "Trash\|trash_" src/ enumerates exactly the kill-list.
title: Mark the kill-list: rename doomed surface/normalize/witness concepts with the Trash trigger
